aiAssistant.title: AI assistant
aiAssistant.description: Ask questions about the selected McHarbor environment.
aiAssistant.footer: Answers use the active McHarbor context and the configured default AI provider.
aiAssistant.backendUnavailable: The AI provider is unavailable. Check Settings > AI and test the default connection.
aiAssistant.rateLimited: The AI provider hit its rate limit. Wait a moment and ask again, or switch to another provider in Settings > AI.

actions.title: Pending AI action
actions.description: Review the dry-run plan before McHarbor changes anything.

prompts.container: Explain this container and identify recent errors.
prompts.stack: Summarize this stack and its deployment errors.
prompts.image: Explain this image and any known issues.
prompts.volume: Explain this volume and its container dependencies.
prompts.network: Explain this network and any connectivity issues.
prompts.pod: Explain this pod and any recent failures.
prompts.deployment: Summarize this deployment and any rollout issues.
prompts.workflow: Explain the most recent workflow failure.
prompts.environment: Give me an overview of this environment.
prompts.fallback: Give me an overview of the current McHarbor setup.

capability.confirmBody: The AI wants to run "{{label}}". Continue?
